messages:
samir patel: Hey team — first day here. I'm blocked on HubSpot and Dialpad setup. HubSpot keeps redirecting me to SSO and then shows 'No account found', and Dialpad MFA keeps rejecting my SMS codes. Any quick triage steps? @lina

lina (sales-ops): Hey Samir, welcome! Quick q: did you sign up with your redwood.com email or a personal one? Also can you paste the exact HubSpot message or a screenshot?

samir patel: signed up with samir@redwood.com. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/fake-screenshot (looping SSO error)

lina (sales-ops): Got it. Common fixes: clear cookies + try incognito, or click 'Sign in with SAML' and explicitly pick 'Redwood SSO'. If it still loops I can force-create your HubSpot record from Sales Ops (admin console). For Dialpad: go to Settings → Security → Multi-factor and re-add your phone. If SMS never arrives we can add an authenticator app fallback. If you want, DM me your phone and I’ll add a temporary bypass.

onboarding-bot: Account provisioning: HubSpot invite sent to samir@redwood.com. Expected propagation ~5-10 minutes.

ben_wallace: Adding — playbooks and call scripts are in Notion: https://redwood.notion.so/sales-playbooks. For a starter pack I can DM a 1-page one-pager + sample call opening. Also, for Dialpad quick fix: sometimes older browser extensions block the SMS flow; try disabling extensions or use your phone's browser to confirm.

maria gomez: Samir — hey and welcome! Two priorities this week: 1) verify CRM + call tools, 2) skim the 'Intro to Redwood product' doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday 10am calendar invite sent. If you want shadowing, say the word and I’ll pair you on calls next week.

samir patel: HubSpot invite just arrived, logged in ok. Dialpad still asked for SMS, I retried and code finally worked. One last Q: where are the customer-facing one-pagers and objection handling scripts?

lina (sales-ops): Collateral lives in GDrive > Sales > Collateral > Customer Facing. Quick link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood-collateral. Objection handling is under the Notion playbook 'pricing objections'. If you can't find something, ping me with the customer name and I'll surface the right doc.

ben_wallace: I'll drop a 3-min Loom with the call opening + a 1-page script into #sales later today, and attach a sample email template you can use for follow-ups.

samir patel: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup: Appreciate the fast help!

lina (sales-ops): Marking this thread resolved. If anything flares up DM me or post here and we'll escalate to IT if needed. :wave:
